description: When a prescription is filled at an integrated pharmacy, a FILL_CONTACT is created in the order, and all related fill information is recorded in this FILL_CONTACT. A prescription may have multiple fills, and this item indicates whether the fill is partial. If the patient can only afford a smaller quantity or if the pharmacy has a limited supply of the medication, the dispensed amount may differ from the intended amount specified by the prescriber. For instance, if a patient has a fill for 30 tablets intended for a 30-day supply, a partial fill of 15 tablets will provide a 15-day supply, with the remainder available for later pickup when the patient can pay or when more stock is available. This flag is also utilized in adjudication to inform the insurer that the fill is partial, prompting an adjustment in the payment amount.

For the system-recorded check-in time, refer to the SIGNIN_AUD_DTTM column in PATIENT_ENC_7.

name: TEMPERATURE

description: The timestamp when this patient encounter was included in enterprise reporting.

description: This column is populated solely for indemnity coverages (COVERAGE_TYPE_C equal to 1) and contains the unique identifier for the benefit plan linked to the coverage record. description: The financial class associated with this coverage is utilized solely for CMS claims forms and may not be consistently populated for reporting purposes. Reporting should be conducted using the financial class of the payor indicated in this coverage.

description: The title of the visit provider. Refer to VISIT_PROV_ID above for the definition of visit provider.

description: This column contains a value of 1 if the dispense preparation was initiated but not finished in the Dispense Preparation activity; otherwise, it holds a value of 0. description: This column contains a value of 1 if the dispense was successfully completed during the Dispense Preparation activity; otherwise, it contains a value of 0.
name: DISP_PREP_COMPLETED_BOOL

description: The date when the dispense was prepared during the Dispense Preparation activity or in an external system.
name: DISP_PREP_DATE

description: The date and time when the dispense was prepared during the Dispense Preparation activity or in an external system.
name: DISP_PREP_DTTM

description: The hour of the day when the dispense was prepared during the Dispense Preparation activity or by an external system.
name: DISP_PREP_HOUR

The warning types evaluated for near misses are: 35010 - Dispense Prep NDC Not Part of Order and 35011 - Dispense Prep NDC Expired.
name: DISP_PREP_NEAR_MISS_BOOL

description: This column contains a value of 0 if a dispense was either prepared or attempted during the Dispense Preparation activity, or if dispense preparation data was obtained from an external system. If neither condition is met, it holds a value of 1.
name: DISP_PREP_NOT_ATTEMPTED_BOOL

description: The unique identifier for the user linked to the order event action record.
name: DISP_PREP_USER_ID

description: This column contains "Y" if the dispense contact has a return contact that references it, and "N" if it does not. A partial return is treated as a return.

name: DISP_TYPE_CODE

description: The unique identifier for the user who performed this dispense.
name: DISP_USER_ID

description: This column contains the count of warnings related to "NDC Expired", "CNR Expired", "NDC Expiring Soon", and "CNR Expiring Soon" (warning types 35011, 35013, 35050, or 35052) for this dispense, excluding any duplicate warnings.
name: EXP_MED_ALT_CNT

description: The CATEGORY_VALUE of the general dispense type of the dispense is determined by the actual dispense type and several other factors, including the pharmacy type and order attributes. This column is often used to connect to the ZC_GEN_DISP_TYPE table.
name: GEN_DISP_TYPE_CODE

description: This column contains a value of 1 if the dispense was modified by an interface message from an external dispense preparation system; otherwise, it holds a value of 0.
name: INTERFACE_PREP_COMPLETED_BOOL

description: The unique internal contact date for the most recent receive action in the Dispense Tracking activity. This column, along with ACTION_ID, is commonly used to connect to the V_PHARMACY_DISPENSE_ACTION view.
name: LAST_RECEIVE_ACTION_DATE_REAL

description: The unique internal contact date of the most recent action sent in the Dispense Tracking activity. This column, along with ACTION_ID, is commonly used to connect to the V_PHARMACY_DISPENSE_ACTION view.
name: LAST_SENT_ACTION_DATE_REAL

description: The ID of the location linked to the pharmacy that is responsible for this dispense.
name: LOCATION_ID

description: The name of the location linked to the pharmacy that is responsible for this dispense.
name: LOCATION_NAME

description: This column contains the count of manually linked ingredients for the warning types "NDC Not Part of Order" and "CNR Doesn't Match Order" (35010 or 35012) related to this dispense.
name: MANUAL_ASSOC_INGRED_CNT

description: This column contains the unique ID of the medication that is the dispensable product for the order. It is commonly used to reference the MEDICATIONS table, and in the case of IMS, it selects the medication record assessed for IMS instead of the IMS mixture template; manually bulk charged orders will have a value of NULL.
name: MEDICATION_ID

description: The name assigned to the medication.
name: MEDICATION_NAME

description: This column indicates the total count of NDCs that were entered manually for this dispense.
name: NDC_MANUAL_CNT

description: The unique identifier for the medication order.
name: ORDER_MED_ID

description: This column contains "Y" when the dispense is pending and "N" otherwise.
name: PENDING_FLAG

description: The ID of the PHARMACY that is accountable for this dispense.
name: PHARMACY_ID

description: The name of the PHARMACY that is accountable for this dispense.
name: PHARMACY_NAME

description: The designation of the pharmacy's physical type.
name: PHYSICAL_TYPE

description: Indicates the physical type of the pharmacy, which may include options such as Standard Inpatient Pharmacy, Automated Dispensing System, Robotic Dispensing System, Pill Counter, etc. The default value is Standard.
name: PHYSICAL_TYPE_CODE

description: This column contains the count of "NDC Not Part of Order" and "CNR Doesn't Match Order" warnings (warning types 35010, 35012, or 35059) related to this dispense, excluding any duplicate warnings.
name: WRONG_MED_ALT_CNT

description: This column contains "Y" if the dispense had an overridden alert for either "NDC Not Part of Order" or "Compound Not Part of Order" during preparation; otherwise, it contains "N".
name: WRONG_MED_ALT_OVERRIDDEN_FLAG

description: Indicates whether this order was processed using an override.
name: ADS_OVERRIDE_FLAG

description: This column shows if the ADS override is associated with a clinical order. A "Y" signifies it is linked, while an "N" indicates it is not linked; no value will be returned if the order is not an ADS override.
name: ADS_OVERRIDE_LINKED_FLAG

description: The provider who authorizes the order, typically associated with the PROVIDERS table.
name: AUTHORIZING_PROV_ID

description: Specifies whether this order is part of the bulk charge activity.
name: BULK_CHARGE_FLAG

description: Indicates whether the order is conditional. A conditional order will not be initiated until the patient meets a specified set of criteria after it has been released.
name: CONDITIONAL_FLAG

description: The minimum quantity of the medication that can be ordered, as indicated by the user in the orders activity.
name: DISCRETE_DOSE

description: The category number associated with the route of administration for a medication.
name: DISPENSE_ROUTE_CODE

description: The measurement unit for the prescribed dose.
name: DOSE_UNIT

description: The CATEGORY_NUMBER for the dose unit of a medication.
name: DOSE_UNIT_CODE

description: The unique identifier for the encounter associated with the order. This number is distinct for all patient encounters and is used to join with the PATIENT_ENCOUNTERS table.
name: ENCOUNTER_ID

description: The unique internal contact date for the first administration contact related to the order. This date reflects the first contact based on the recorded time, rather than when the documentation was completed, and is often used to connect to the ORDER_DISPENSE_INFO table.
name: FIRST_ADMIN_DATE_REAL

description: The line number for the information related to the MAR action that established the first administration contact, FIRST_ADMIN_DATE_REAL. Only actions that create administration contacts and indicate a patient receiving medication (MED_ADMIN_RECORDS.MAR_ACTION_CODE is 1-Given, 6-New Bag, 12-Bolus, 13-Push, or custom actions mapped to these) are considered. This column is commonly used to connect to the MED_ADMIN_RECORDS table.
name: FIRST_ADMIN_DATE_REAL_LINE

description: The unique internal date of the first dispense contact for the order. This column is often utilized to connect to the ORDER_DISPENSE_INFO table.
name: FIRST_DISPENSE_DATE_REAL

description: The unique internal contact date for the initial pend verify contact associated with the order. This column is often utilized to connect to the ORDER_DISPENSE_INFO table.
name: FIRST_PEND_VERIFY_DATE_REAL

description: The initial scheduled due time for the medication order. If modified during order verification, it is updated to reflect the new date and time.
name: FIRST_SCHED_DUE_TIME_DTTM

description: The unique internal date of the first verification contact for the order. This column is often used to connect to the ORDER_DISPENSE_INFO table.
name: FIRST_VERIFY_DATE_REAL

description: The line number for the data related to the most recent action in the verification queue during the order verification process. If the order has been verified, this represents the verification audit trail associated with FIRST_VERIFY_DATE_REAL and is often used to connect to the RX_VERIFY_TRACE table.
name: FIRST_VERIFY_DATE_REAL_LINE

description: The unique identifier for the discrete frequency record related to this medication order. This column is commonly used to connect to the IP_FREQUENCY table.
name: FREQ_ID

description: The designation of the order frequency.
name: FREQ_NAME

description: This column records the date and time when a conditional order was initiated.
name: INITIATED_DTTM

description: This indicates if an order has been released. Unreleased orders lack a report date, so when using the REPORT_DATE column for a date range, signed and held orders will be automatically excluded.
name: IS_RELEASED_FLAG

description: Specifies if an intervention has been recorded for this order. A "Y" signifies that at least one intervention is documented, while an "N" indicates that no interventions are recorded.
name: IVENT_FLAG

description: The unique internal contact date of the most recent verification contact for the order initiated by a user. This date pertains to the last verification contact where MEDICATION_ORDERS.MED_VERIFY_TYPE_CODE is not 4-Modify On Patient Transfer, 5-Modify On Order Transfer, or 6-NDC replacement. This column is often used to connect to the ORDER_DISPENSE_INFO table for details on changes made to orders that have undergone reverification. The last verification contact, irrespective of verify type, is available in ORDER_RXVER_NOADSN.LAST_VERIFY_DATE_REAL.
name: LAST_VERIFY_DATE_REAL

description: Columns with Medication IDs in MEDICATION_ORDERS and its related addendum tables may include Orderable records or templates that do not correspond to actual medications. description: The name assigned to the medication.

description: Indicates if the order was submitted as non-formulary before verification. A "Y" signifies a non-formulary medication.
name: NF_PRE_VERIFY_FLAG

description: This column indicates whether the order was a non-clinical override in the case of an ADS override. Non-clinical overrides result in charge-only orders that are not displayed on the MAR.

description: Indicates if the ORDER is a one-step medication, meaning its administration is recorded in a single step.
